annotationRationale: Recognizing similar right triangles and matching their corresponding sides produces both equations. Equal, parallel, and perpendicular square sides supply the required lengths and angles.
sourceMethod: Follows the official similar-triangle method, including the two portions of the length-3 leg in the second placement. All points and side correspondences are defined in words.

review.mathCheck: The first configuration gives x²=(3−x)(4−x), hence x=12/7. In the second, AG=3y/5 and BG=5y/4, so their sum 3 gives y=60/37. Therefore x/y=37/35, choice D. Both vertex orders and the stated angle and side correspondences are geometrically valid.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded, faithful expansion of MAA solution 19. It reproduces both official similarity equations and explains the segment lengths shown in the supplied figures. Its new labels are internally consistent and sufficient to reconstruct the configurations.
review.annotationCheck: Similarity criteria and corresponding-side proportions are assessed; square properties are correctly supporting. Other similarity tests, perimeter/area properties, and quadrilateral classification are not assessed.
